description: This file defines the `TranscriptsStore` actor for managing a log of transcript entries, including reading from and writing to a file in the user's Library directory, and an extension on `String` to append lines to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: An actor responsible for storing and managing transcript entries, supporting appending new entries, loading existing ones, and keeping the number within a specified limit.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the store by setting up the directory, reading existing transcript data, and populating entries.

methods.name: append(text:)
methods.description: Appends a new text entry to the transcript, maintaining the limit and writing to disk.

methods.name: latest()
methods.description: Returns the current list of transcript entries.
